import ThemeCreator from '../../../components/themes/ThemeCreator.astro';

Make your own theme: start from one of the [shipped themes](/argus-table/themes/), change a few seeds (accent, surface, header, lines, rows, type, depth), fine-tune any token or part, and check contrast in light and dark. Copy or download the CSS, or copy a link that opens this page with your theme. Your draft is kept in this browser.

Or let your coding agent start one: the [`argus-table-theme` skill](https://github.com/Joessst-Dev/argus-table/tree/main/skills#readme) turns your brand colours, fonts or website into a link that opens the creator with your theme.
